# Encyclopaedia identity and ordinary-Hut scope review

ACCEPT the finite source assessment and exact single-row prerequisite update. Encyclopaedia rich-text/link rendering is not required for the bounded ordinary Mission1 Hut interaction while that native window remains closed. Runtime implementation remains HOLD for the ordinary shared-owner/guard contract and playable validation.

Bound assessment: `issue19-tooltip-controller-source-20261009/work/orchestration/tooltip-topic-layout-20261009-1317/topic-layout-assessment.md`, SHA256 `dfd224510338111983ac9b27e1cd2afd53f20a6309d6daed59d8aeb11c858a58`; receipt `56c81c85b628b724e4d0137935ebe5a28c44d4562116bea012814d61099e5fc4`. Research head is `0bc8f287b7bee4820c5440a6174a0230a6a4e4bd`; explicit application comparison is `47680b8fd124aab50b0528eea77a81cacb556060`.

Independent readback verified all 15 source pins against the named commits/current files, 12 artifact hashes/sizes, 294 disassembly byte lines in three windows against the unchanged inert EXE, and five direct caller context/call targets. The recovered language member is exactly 207,264 bytes with SHA256 `e826c478746d666a3ea9ea36cb7804d1d226d5f83084230987b1de293066cf7d`, matching the existing imported language identity. UTF-16LE/NUL indexing independently reproduces offsets, lengths and hashes of entries983,984,996. The retained extraction receipt records the approved one-member data recovery; this review neither re-extracted data nor ran any original/application/test code. Research checkout remained clean.

The source distinction is concrete:

- `005227b3` supplies configuration index2 to `00451370`; a zero result skips the `0045e730` presenter. The already-retained `004aa4e0` input route likewise requires configuration2 plus pending input before `0045ea00`. Excluding this window therefore excludes these two rich-text entry routes, without asserting universal absence of unrelated or indirect text calls.
- Language index983 identifies the side list as Main Menu; default984 identifies Populous Encyclopaedia; class2 topic table `0059d814` maps Hut models1–3 to article996. The current ordinary local small-Hut name uses imported string908. Its imported bytes agree with the recovered language, and indices983/984/996 are absent from the existing tooltip/campaign subsets. Ordinary Hut naming does not require importing the Encyclopaedia article.
- `0045d8c0` owns pane and scrollbar geometry; its neighboring topic984 setter is distinguished from the layout function. `0045dcb0` loads the current topic text, refreshes the body widget, resets its own scroll/range on dirty content, and computes offsets/thumb/range in the stated order. The signed content-offset division, unsigned thumb division and lack of an invented final range clamp are preserved. These scroll fields are distinct from tooltip D/T.
- The accepted earlier control-hit work occurs before the body extents are recomputed in that presenter visit. Last-painted ownership and repeated-enable saved-mode overwrite remain relevant native history.

The exact one-row update SHA256 `9a28c9e0521a4bf20ef7ba5ef8c96873535af6dfe40e7251ea55e916dc4d5053` matches its pinned base `window2-control-closure.md` and replaces exactly one row. It retains mode0 and configuration2-clear admission under the other native predicates; configuration clear alone cannot imply ordinary mode after repeated enable. The earlier mode17 release binding remains prior to ordinary case73. Browser Help/settings is a separate current feature whose interruption behavior needs port integration proof, not a claim of native Encyclopaedia equivalence.

The other seven shared-state/guard rows remain unchanged. The ordinary witness must preserve startup and HUD/cell/forced/inspection history rather than resetting caches on first hover. This source result does not itself approve the proposed broad witness or an implementation mapping. It removes a demonstrated unrelated rendering prerequisite from the closed-window scope, and does not erase admitted original history.

Generic text/link widgets and history helpers, including the meaning of article insertion tags, remain unresolved only for the separate Encyclopaedia feature. No parser expansion or new external-input blocker follows this result. Publication may retain titles, numeric IDs/tags, hashes, bounded code and provenance; raw archive/EXE/language and full articles remain excluded. No new runtime or research authorization is created by this verdict.
